message.content: This editorial illustration features a magazine cover with a yellow background and a prominent red vertical bar on the left edge. The masthead "TEMPO" is printed in large white serif letters. Above it, text reads "BEN ANDERSON: ZIARAH TERAKHIR SEORANG PEMBANGKANG". Centered is a stylized illustration of a man in a black suit, white shirt, and black tie, wearing white socks and black shoes. He is depicted in a dynamic dance pose reminiscent of Michael Jackson, with one hand on his black fedora and the other hand extended outward. His body is slightly translucent, with the yellow background showing through. To the right, large black text says "GOYANG MUNDUR SETYA," followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Mengapa ‘Tim Barito’ tak mampu..." In the top right corner, a small grayscale photograph shows the face of an elderly man with glasses. The bottom right corner contains a price of "RP 39.500", a website URL, publication details, and a barcode. The date "21-27 DESEMBER 2015" is printed in small white text below the masthead.
